name: the lumber yard and warehouse announced for the opening of navigation, 1834
trade: lumber yard and store house, on sale and commission

proprietors.name: David Carver
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card carver_david (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: No street the model holds. The paper gives no anchor.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1833-12-31, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read other: David Carver (other). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
